title: Properties of Materials
seo_title: Year 1 Science: Properties of Materials Worksheets (Hard, Soft, Waterproof)
standard_text: Describe the simple physical properties of a variety of everyday materials. Compare and group together a variety of everyday materials on the basis of their simple physical properties.
meta_desc: Free Year 1 science worksheets on the properties of materials: hard and soft, rough and smooth, shiny and dull, bendy, waterproof and absorbent, sorting and a soaking-up test. 100 questions with answers.
key_sub: Hard or soft, rough or smooth, waterproof or absorbent.
body_html:
How to think about it

Materials have properties.

  • Hard or soft, rough or smooth, shiny or dull.
  • Bendy or stiff, waterproof or absorbent, see-through or not.
  • We can sort materials by their properties.
Example

Sandpaper feels?

Bumpy

Answer: rough

Example

A sponge soaks up water. It is?

Soaks up

Answer: absorbent

Common mistakes

  • Thinking shiny means hard.
  • Thinking waterproof means it floats.
  • Thinking glass is soft because it is smooth.

faq.q: What are the properties of a material?
faq.a: Words that describe how it looks and feels and what it does: hard, soft, rough, smooth, shiny, dull, bendy, stiff, stretchy, waterproof, absorbent, see-through.
It does not let water through, like a plastic raincoat or a wellington boot.
Put materials with the same property together, for example all the hard things in one group and all the soft things in another.
